headline: Operators Bring New Dredges to Argentina's Paraná River Waterway Amid El Niño
summary: Jan de Nul and Servimagnus, operators of the Paraná River waterway, are bringing in new dredges to alleviate flooding caused by the El Niño phenomenon.
why: The Paraná River waterway is a vital artery for agricultural commodity exports from South America to global markets.

impacts.name: Agricultural Shipping
impacts.why: Dredging operations help maintain shipping channel capacity during weather disruptions.
